_why: John, 12 Oct 2026. Two word lists, each approved once. (1) `ust_substitutions`: words the UST uses that read oddly beside every other English Bible (Mark test: “apprentices” for disciples). Each is changed wherever it occurs in the listed books, and the UST credit says so (“some words changed”), as CC BY-SA requires. Counts are occurrences in the UST Gospels when drafted. (2) `plain_words`: translators' terms in tN outline items and headings (Leviticus 11: “quadrupeds”), shown in plain words. Nothing here is approved until status is 'approved' (rule 2). Approved by John on 12 Oct 2026 with two fixes, each the BSB's own word: “Dwelling” → “tabernacle” (BSB 126 times, Exodus 26:1) and “Box of the Testimony” → “ark of the Testimony” (Exodus 25:22). tN uses “Box of the Testimony” only in Exodus and Numbers, where the BSB also says “ark of the Testimony”.
